assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Atherosclerotic heart disease is coded I25.10
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded I34.0
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded CPT 93229
The purpose is to correlate intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias
The purpose is to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
Continuous ambulatory monitoring is medically necessary to detect clinically significant arrhythmias driving the recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The diagnostic monitoring service is supported by the documented clinical indication and the patient's established cardiac diagnoses
